description: Is this dependency current, and does the version in use have known vulnerabilities? Takes a package name and returns the latest version, deprecation/license, and advisories from OSV.dev with the version that fixes each. Accepts 'lodash@4.17.20' (npm-style), 'requests==2.19.0' (PyPI-style), or a prefix: npm:, pypi:, cargo:, go:, gem:. Backed by the live registries — no guessing.
name: check_deps
